// THE GRAB'S SOUNDS. Logical names on the left are what the code asks for;
// lump names on the right are our own RSQDG-prefixed files, generated by
// tools/gen_sounds.py (original, procedural -- no samples from anywhere).
//
// Every one of them is pitch-shifted at play time by the object's mass (light
// is high, heavy is low), so one set covers a clip and a barrel. See feel.zs.

rsqdg/lock    RSQDGLOK
rsqdg/launch  RSQDGLNC
rsqdg/hum     RSQDGHUM
rsqdg/catch   RSQDGCAT
rsqdg/drop    RSQDGDRP

// The hum's pitch is driven by the code from launch to catch; an engine-side
// random pitch would fight it.
$pitchshift rsqdg/hum 0

// Several pulls in a row should not cut each other off mid-tick, but a room
// full of drops should not stack into a roar either.
$limit rsqdg/lock  4
$limit rsqdg/catch 4
$limit rsqdg/drop  4
